name: Find text
statement:
/*
Find specific text in repository
*/

DECLARE @s nvarchar(4000) = '%:1%'

SELECT [Action] = 'Import', [Type] = 'Table', [Name] = '[' + S.Schema_Name + '].[' + T.Table_Name + ']', [SubAction] = 'PreSQL' 
FROM 
	CFG.IMP_TABLE_REFERENCES R
	INNER JOIN CFG.TABLES T ON
		T.TableID = R.TableID
	INNER JOIN CFG.SCHEMAS S ON
		S.SchemaID = T.SchemaID
WHERE
	R.PreSQL LIKE @s
UNION ALL SELECT 'Import', 'Table', '[' + S.Schema_Name + '].[' + T.Table_Name + ']', 'PostSQL'
FROM 
	CFG.IMP_TABLE_REFERENCES R
	INNER JOIN CFG.TABLES T ON
		T.TableID = R.TableID
	INNER JOIN CFG.SCHEMAS S ON
		S.SchemaID = T.SchemaID
WHERE
	R.PostSQL LIKE @s
UNION SELECT 'Historization', 'Table', '[' + S.Schema_Name + '].[' + T.Table_Name + ']', 'PreSQL'
FROM 
	CFG.HIST_TABLE_REFERENCES R
	INNER JOIN CFG.TABLES T ON
		T.TableID = R.TableID
	INNER JOIN CFG.SCHEMAS S ON
		S.SchemaID = T.SchemaID
WHERE
	R.PreSQL LIKE @s
UNION ALL SELECT 'Historization', 'Table', '[' + S.Schema_Name + '].[' + T.Table_Name + ']', 'PostSQL'
FROM 
	CFG.HIST_TABLE_REFERENCES R
	INNER JOIN CFG.TABLES T ON
		T.TableID = R.TableID
	INNER JOIN CFG.SCHEMAS S ON
		S.SchemaID = T.SchemaID
WHERE
	R.PostSQL LIKE @s
UNION SELECT 'Persisting', 'Transformation', '[' + S.Schema_Name + '].[' + T.Transformation_Name + ']', 'PreSQL'
FROM 
	CFG.PERS_TABLE_REFERENCES R
	INNER JOIN CFG.TRANSFORMATIONS T ON
		T.TableID = R.TransformationID
	INNER JOIN CFG.SCHEMAS S ON
		S.SchemaID = T.SchemaID
WHERE
	R.PreSQL LIKE @s
UNION SELECT 'Persisting', 'Transformation', '[' + S.Schema_Name + '].[' + T.Transformation_Name + ']', 'PostSQL'
FROM 
	CFG.PERS_TABLE_REFERENCES R
	INNER JOIN CFG.TRANSFORMATIONS T ON
		T.TableID = R.TransformationID
	INNER JOIN CFG.SCHEMAS S ON
		S.SchemaID = T.SchemaID
WHERE
	R.PostSQL LIKE @s
UNION SELECT 'Script transformation', 'Transformation', '[' + S.Schema_Name + '].[' + T.Transformation_Name + ']', 'PreSQL'
FROM 
	CFG.TRANS_TABLE_REFERENCES R
	INNER JOIN CFG.TRANSFORMATIONS T ON
		T.TableID = R.TransformationID
	INNER JOIN CFG.SCHEMAS S ON
		S.SchemaID = T.SchemaID
WHERE
	R.PreSQL LIKE @s
UNION SELECT 'Script transformation', 'Transformation', '[' + S.Schema_Name + '].[' + T.Transformation_Name + ']', 'PostSQL'
FROM 
	CFG.TRANS_TABLE_REFERENCES R
	INNER JOIN CFG.TRANSFORMATIONS T ON
		T.TableID = R.TransformationID
	INNER JOIN CFG.SCHEMAS S ON
		S.SchemaID = T.SchemaID
WHERE
	R.PostSQL LIKE @s
UNION SELECT 'Script', T.Type_Name, R.Script_Name, 'Script'
FROM 
	CFG.SCRIPTS R
	INNER JOIN INTERN.SCRIPT_TYPES T ON
		T.ScriptTypeID = R.ScriptTypeID
WHERE
	R.Script LIKE @s
UNION SELECT 'Table', 'Table', '[' + S.Schema_Name + '].[' + T.Table_Name + ']', 'PreSQL'
FROM 
	CFG.TABLES T
	INNER JOIN CFG.SCHEMAS S ON
		S.SchemaID = T.SchemaID
WHERE
	T.PreSQL LIKE @s
UNION SELECT 'Table', 'Table', '[' + S.Schema_Name + '].[' + T.Table_Name + ']', 'PostSQL'
FROM 
	CFG.TABLES T
	INNER JOIN CFG.SCHEMAS S ON
		S.SchemaID = T.SchemaID
WHERE
	T.PostSQL LIKE @s
UNION SELECT 'Transformation', 'Transformation', '[' + S.Schema_Name + '].[' + T.Transformation_Name + ']', 'View text'
FROM 
	CFG.TRANSFORMATIONS T
	INNER JOIN CFG.SCHEMAS S ON
		S.SchemaID = T.SchemaID
WHERE
	T.ViewDefinition LIKE @s
UNION SELECT 'Macro', 'Macro', T.MacroName, 'Macro text'
FROM 
	CFG.MACROS T
WHERE
	T.Statement LIKE @s
